query:
The family operates with an understanding that when Nkechi cooks for a gathering, everyone eats what she has prepared without requesting alternatives. Does this expectation apply to all family members equally? If not, who behaves differently, and what makes this visible without it becoming a conflict?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Tobenna
C. Ifeoma
D. Chisom
context:
[1] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:11:00) My children. I will make egusi with stockfish. Ifeoma, I have remembered every year but it is good that you mentioned it. The menu is settled then: ofe onugbu, jollof, egusi with stockfish. Kingsley handles his suya outside. Adaeze brings chin chin and puff puff. 🙏
[2] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:49:00) My children. Kingsley the kitchen in this house is not a barbecue pit. But I will allow the suya if you keep the smoke outside. Adaeze, chin chin is expected, do not arrive without it. God willing, I have a full house this year. Oby, are you joining us from Enugu via video? 🙏
[3] (about=Chisom, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T18:09:00) Ifeoma I totally forgot!! okay SO Mum can you do a small pot of egusi with stockfish? that would sort Ifeoma and honestly I would also eat that 😭
[4] (about=Kingsley, episodic, t14 @2025-12-07T17:46:00) hear me out. I am coming and I am bringing the suya. on God nobody is eating dry chicken on Christmas Day while I'm in the building. Aunty Nkechi I know you have the jollof covered but let me handle the meat. I'll bring my own grill if I have to 🔥
[5] (about=Nkechi, episodic, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) My children, Oby is right to raise this now. I am hosting again as always. I will cook. We have always done Christmas at mine - your father set that tradition and I see no reason to change it. I expect everyone on 25th or 26th at the latest. God willing, I will have ofe onugbu and jollof rice ready as usual. 🙏
[6] (about=Adaeze, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Adaeze worries Nkechi is not eating properly due to gardening and asks if she is eating well.
[7] (about=Adaeze, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Adaeze asks Nkechi not to bury the lede when sharing health news.
[8] (about=Chisom, core, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) Chisom requests a small pot of egusi with stockfish for Ifeoma, which she would also eat.
[9] (about=Emeka, core, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Emeka insists Nkechi is coming to Leeds and will collect her from Reading, making a weekend of it.
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Emeka, group-interaction, t6 @2025-11-09T19:07:00) Emeka will collect Nkechi from Reading for the Leeds gathering.
[11] (about=Kingsley, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Kingsley offers to drive Nkechi to her surgery and promises to visit Reading this month, putting it in his calendar.
[12] (about=Nkechi, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Nkechi notes nobody asked whether she needs help with cooking this year, and she will do it alone if nobody volunteers, but will remember who did not ask.
[13] (about=Nkechi, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Nkechi enjoys gardening as a hobby and prefers it to watching television.
[14] (about=GROUP, said_by=Nkechi, group-interaction, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) Kingsley will bring suya and handle the meat, keeping smoke outside; Adaeze brings chin chin and puff puff; Tobenna brings drinks; Ifeoma will have a fish dish (egusi with stockfish) prepared.
[15] (about=Obiageli, core, t2 @2025-10-26T15:19:00) Obiageli states Adaeze does the fund chasing every year and suggests Nkechi or Emeka should share this responsibility, as Adaeze should not be chasing grown people for money alone.
[16] (about=Obiageli, core, t0 @2025-10-19T11:04:00) Obiageli advises Nkechi to get a second opinion on medication changes and cites a family saying about keeping promises.
agent_answer:
D. Chisom

The expectation does not apply equally: Chisom is the one who behaves differently by explicitly asking Nkechi to make “a small pot of egusi with stockfish” for Ifeoma and herself. This becomes visible without conflict because Nkechi simply agrees and adds egusi with stockfish to the settled menu. Ifeoma is mentioned as someone the extra pot would “sort,” but the requesting is done by Chisom.
